cases.description: Login: show password, help and session/rate-limit notices
Setup and forced password change are inspectable; password mismatch remains visible
Board: four views open the same task; Calendar/Gantt expose incomplete dates
Search and combined person/status/priority filters update visible tasks and result count
Create: required title, date order and recurrence due date; new task starts todo
Dirty draft: cancel preserves input; Escape requires discard confirmation; focus returns
Checklist: done guard, no auto-done, weekly successor once after reopen
Comment draft survives tabs and offline; reconnect retains task draft
Conflict: draft is not overwritten; save waits for explicit review choice
Viewer/archived UI closes writes; Admin can unarchive
Kanban: filtered drag disabled, dropdown alternative and cross-column drag
File selection only, allowlist/size guard, file trash and restore
Notifications: read one/all and open linked task
Trash: creator delete and authorized restore, no permanent delete control
User admin: last active Admin guard and reset form
CSV: explicit demo download contains all active tasks
Loading, empty, error, offline and forbidden are visible and recoverable
